description: One-task live-provider smoke test for RepoRuntimeBench. This is not a solve-rate claim.

tasks.prompt: Fix app/calculator.py so add returns the sum of its arguments. Inspect the implementation, make the smallest safe edit, and report the result.
tasks.verifier: python -c "from app.calculator import add; assert add(2, 3) == 5; assert add(-2, 1) == -1"
